purpose: Record the exact manifest digest behind every image reference the deployment surface names, and how each one was resolved, so a pinned tag can be audited later instead of trusted.

resolution.scope: linux/amd64 only - the single platform G0-01 qualified the dependency lock for

images.note: The same digest the frozen lock records as its resolver image, so the interpreter that installs the lock is the one the lock was frozen against.
Also the database the inherited unit-test workflow uses, so the empty-database migrations here exercise the same major version.

not_pinned_here: The application image itself is built from this repository, so it is identified by its build inputs and its resulting image id/digest recorded in evidence/g0-02/, not by a registry digest.
ghcr.io/oras-project etc. are not used by this deployment surface.
